name: Calistoga
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Hot days give color and big berry fruit, while cool nights keep acidity, structure and power.

blurb.text: A Napa Valley sub-area in the northwest of the county, around but not covering the whole town of Calistoga. The town was founded in 1857, and vineyards were established there in 1862.
